notes: L1 import { type ReactNode } from 'react' -> React + type ReactNode from 'react' (native also needs the JSX runtime).

L2 import { MapContainer, MapTileLayer } from '@/components/maps' -> Leaflet/react-leaflet renders tiles to the DOM with no native analogue: reimplemented as a static native 'map surface' View (the same dark-canvas treatment the sibling TripPlannerMap port uses). The interactive tile map, real tile fetching, and leaflet pan/zoom are DOM-only and intentionally unavailable on native (documented).

L3 import { EmptyState } from '@/components/feedback' -> native EmptyState (../../../../../components/feedback/EmptyState); the web message is preserved verbatim and a concise native-additive title (EMPTY_TITLE 'No map data') is supplied because native EmptyState requires a title (TripPlannerMap precedent).
L4 import { cn } from '@/lib/cn' -> cn only merged the DOM className onto the wrapper div; a React Native View has no className, so cn is unnecessary and dropped (documented).

L6-14 interface WidgetMapViewProps {center, zoom?, compact?, children?, className?, emptyMessage?, isEmpty?} -> ported verbatim; className is kept for prop-shape parity but is inert in native (mirrors the shared/index.ts barrel contract).

L16-24 component signature + defaults (zoom=13, compact=false, emptyMessage='No location data available', isEmpty=false) -> export function WidgetMapView with the same defaults (DEFAULT_ZOOM=13, DEFAULT_EMPTY_MESSAGE='No location data available'); prop names preserved.

L25-27 if (isEmpty) return <EmptyState message={emptyMessage} className='py-4' /> with the no-action transient-empty-state comment -> same early return: EmptyState message preserved verbatim, no-action comment preserved, web className='py-4' maps to native EmptyState's built-in vertical padding.

L29-30 outer div cn('h-full w-full rounded-lg overflow-hidden', className) -> native container View: flex:1 + width:'100%' (h-full w-full), borderRadius 8 (rounded-lg), overflow:'hidden' (overflow-hidden); className inert. A native-additive minHeight:160 keeps the dark surface visible when the parent leaves height unconstrained (web h-full has no intrinsic height).
